_comment: The subscription gh-event-capture is supposed to have. scripts/check-subscription.sh
compares GET /app against this and exits non-zero on any difference.
This file is the ONLY partial answer we have to the limit stated in README
§ 1: an actor holding organization_administration can unsubscribe the events
or repoint the URL, and GitHub records nothing when they do. The drift check
does not prevent that and cannot. It notices, if it is still running.
Event set: the six scoped by the owner at App creation, plus installation_repositories,
which is the event that fires when a repository joins or leaves the org-admin
installation. The owner's stated rationale was catching exactly that
transition, and it does NOT arrive on `installation` (which covers the whole
installation being created, deleted, suspended or unsuspended). Widening this
list is an owner action on the App settings UI — update this file in the same
change, or the check goes red on a legitimate subscription.
